about_the_game:
A young man, Selim Kara, is found dead under mysterious circumstances.

His computer, encrypted and corrupted after a camera is plugged in, hides something beyond explanation.

You are an agent working for the National Intelligence Center.

Your task: decrypt the files. And don’t look too deep.

💾 WELCOME BACK TO 2005... BUT DIFFERENT.

Boot into a hauntingly familiar desktop.
From chunky icons to broken files and eerie startup sounds — the game recreates a fictional 2005 where the internet feels analog, and every click echoes through time.

It’s nostalgic. But something’s off.
This isn't the 2005 you remember.

👁️ THEY ARE PRETENDING TO BE A HUMAN

As you dig deeper, you begin to question what's real and w̶̜͊͐̊̈̌̒̑̕̕̕͠h̵̡̧̳͍̰͇̩̼͍̜̲̜̔̏̋̏͊͊͠a̴̢̧͕̤̤͍͚̤͚͔̗̅̌̈́̐̉̋̎͝͝t̸̳̞̬͔͖̦̠̀ ̴̨͎̰͙͔̞̫̺̥̠͑́̈̐̄͋͗̊̉̋̒̚͘͝i̸̡̪͇͓͗̋́̐̂̂́̐̉͠s̷̹͓̝͇̯̺͎̩̿̑̔̎̑͠ͅ ̵̲͇̿̒̀n̶̨̝͉͔̱͖̩͎̻̮̦̻͎̭̎̈̈̓̎̄͒̒͜o̷̲̲̱̠̙̽̀͆̈̾̎t̶̝̀͋́̓̆̋́̌̕.̵̡̞̗̰̭̤̲̩͉͔̰̣̻̔̒͗̃̃́̈

Strange behaviors. Files that write themselves.
Something is lurking inside — born not from code, but from memory. Not created by humans, and not meant to be seen.

It learns. It listens. And it doesn’t want to be found.

🧬 TURQUOISE TECHNOLOGIES

Turqoise Company was once a rising star in the global tech industry — famous for its AI breakthroughs and ambitious vision.

But behind closed doors, a classified program known as the Heaven Project was launched.

Sounds good, right? Then experience heaven firsthand in this game.

— and see this terrible madness created by turquoise

📼 STEP INTO THE VIDEOS - Face fears that aren't yours

Selim Kara’s final memories aren’t just recorded — they’re playable.
Each decrypted video becomes a first-person journey through his simulated heaven.
which quickly twists into something much darker.

Walk through memory-made landscapes. Face fears that aren't yours.
And find out what truly went wrong in the Heaven Project.

🖼️ NOSTALGIA AS YOU WANT

We didn’t just simulate the past — we rebuilt it.
From early 2000s internet slang and web design to the sounds of CRT monitors and classic error tones, everything is lovingly crafted to capture a time that's gone... but not forgotten.

This is not retro for the sake of style.
It's memory turned into atmosphere.

🔧 FEATURES

  • 🖥️ A fully interactive retro desktop interface (inspired by Windows 95 & 98)

  • 📂 No HUD, no tutorials — just you, your instincts, and the machine

  • 📼 Six playable memory-videos, each unlocking deeper psychological layers

  • 🌐 Nostalgic 2000s internet: from forums to fake websites, reimagined with eerie accuracy

  • 🧠 Psychological and analog horror drawn from generative AI anomalies

  • 🕰️ Carefully crafted nostalgic atmosphere — not just visual, but emotional

content_descriptors.notes:
Mature Content Description:

This game contains psychological horror elements, unsettling imagery, themes of death and digital consciousness, and moments of intense existential dread.
There is no sexual content or depictions of explicit violence. However, the narrative may include references to self-termination, loss of agency, artificial control over human memories, and fragmented identity.
Players sensitive to themes of isolation, mental breakdown, or corrupted spiritual imagery may find certain sequences disturbing.

Viewer discretion is advised.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-8100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 (4GB) / AMD Radeon R9 380
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended for faster loading
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-11400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 Ti / RTX 2060 / AMD RX 5600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended for faster loading

short_description: Heaven Does Not Respond is a psychological and analog horror investigation game set in an alternate 2005 timeline. Play as intelligence agent, exploring a retro computer interface to decrypt hidden files, watch mysterious videos, and uncover dark secrets behind a young man’s sudden death.
